title: How a game earns its place here
body: Game support at OpenPak is earned, not promised. A title starts as research: we document what its servers must say, with a source for every claim. Then a test rig proves the important paths, and only a title that survives playtesting gets called supported. Today Outbound and Stardew Valley are in playable testing on emulators. Mario Kart 8 Deluxe and Smash Bros. servers exist but have never seen a console, and Splatoon 3 is early research with its requirements written down. We update these pages as each title moves.
